sprint: Sprint 8: Manifest Consolidation and PDF Wave B Publication Closure
problem_statement: write_pr_candidate_manifest() overwrites pr-candidate-manifest.json every run, causing cross-run PR candidates (scenarios that passed in an earlier run but were not re-attempted or regressed in a later run) to be silently dropped from the manifest. This prevents publication readiness from accumulating across runs.

new_functions.name: merge_pr_candidate_manifests(existing, new_manifest)
new_functions.purpose: Merge a new run's PR candidate manifest into an existing one using additive merge strategy
merge_rules: RULE 1: New run's PASSES always overwrite their scenario's entry (latest pass wins)
RULE 2: Old pass entries preserved for scenarios NOT re-attempted in new run
RULE 3: Old pass entries preserved when new run re-attempts and FAILS (no regression demotion)
RULE 4: New run's excluded entries only appear in merged_excluded if NOT already in merged_included

modified_functions.name: write_pr_candidate_manifest(manifest, verification_dir, merge_existing=True)
modified_functions.change: Added merge_existing parameter (default True). When True, reads existing manifest and calls merge_pr_candidate_manifests() before writing. When False, preserves legacy overwrite behavior for test compatibility.

xls_converter_case.before_fix: Run 5 overwrote manifest → XlsConverter dropped from included_examples → manifest shows 0 Wave B candidates from run 1
xls_converter_case.after_fix: Merge logic: Run 5 re-attempted XlsConverter and failed → Rule 3 preserves run 1's pass entry → XlsConverter remains in included_examples
xls_converter_case.resolution: FIXED — XlsConverter stays PR_READY in manifest across run regressions

manifest_schema.included_examples: List of scenarios that are PR candidates (pass or preserved from prior runs)
manifest_schema.excluded_examples: List of scenarios blocked in current run AND not previously passing
manifest_schema.exclusion_reasons: Dict of {verdict: [scenario_ids]} for current run's failures only
manifest_schema.live_publish_attempted: Whether live publish was attempted in current run
manifest_schema.blocked_candidate_count: Count of excluded_examples (current run only, minus previously passing)

integration_points.impact: All subsequent runs will now produce an additive manifest — no behavioral change for first-run or single-family scenarios
Replay validation will now correctly see accumulated candidates from prior runs — publishable_candidate_count >= prior runs' candidates

architecture_verdict: IMPLEMENTED — merge_pr_candidate_manifests() + write_pr_candidate_manifest(merge_existing=True) deployed. Cross-run candidate preservation now active. XlsConverter regression case resolved structurally.
